Put a little moisture on your left tragus
Wear the earpiece there, cable over/behind your ear
Turn it on and increase intensity until you feel a light, pleasant tingling
Keep it at that comfortable level (adjust if it fades or gets stronger)
Use for 30–60 minutes daily, ideally in the morning or split morning + evening
You can use it while reading, working, meditating, or relaxing.
